function bisect_iter(f, a, b, tol)
    hist = Float64[]
    while abs(b - a) > tol
        mid = (a + b) / 2
        push!(hist, mid)
        if hasroot(f, a, mid)
            b = mid
        else
            a = mid
        end
    end
    hist
end

function newton(f, fp, x0; tol=1e-8, verbose=false)
    x = x0
    for k in 1:100 # max number of iterations
        fx = f(x)
        fpx = fp(x)
        if verbose
            println("iteration $k: x=$x,  f(x)=$fx,  f'(x)=$fpx")
        end
        if abs(fx) < tol
            return x, fx, k
        end
        x = x - fx / fpx
    end
end

function fixed_point(g, x, n)
    xs = [x]
    for k in 1:n
        x = g(x)
        append!(xs, x)
    end
    xs
end

function newton_hist(f, fp, x0; tol=1e-12)
    x = x0
    hist = []
    for k in 1:100 # max number of iterations
        fx = f(x)
        fpx = fp(x)
        push!(hist, [x fx fpx])
        if abs(fx) < tol
            return vcat(hist...) # concatenate arrays
        end
        x = x - fx / fpx
    end
end
